promptText:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI desktop app redesign concept
Input image role: the visible source screenshot is a reference image for layout, state, and information architecture, not an edit target that must be pixel-preserved.
Primary request: Redesign 04-B-01-home-dashboard/default as a calm TOPIK study dashboard.
Direction: editorial progress ledger.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 screenshot with fixed left sidebar. Redesign the dashboard like a precise study ledger: strong typographic hierarchy, compact stats, list-like recent feedback, restrained right rail utilities, clear quick-start and exam areas. Preserve the original dashboard state and core modules.
Style/medium: high-fidelity web UI mockup, Ant Design-friendly compact operational workspace.
Color palette: Mist #f4f4f5 canvas, Snow/Fog flat surfaces, Ink/Obsidian text, dark #09090b CTA only.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans font, compact density, weight-driven hierarchy, no letter spacing.
Constraints: all surfaces flat and neutral; workspace radii 4-8px; no drop-shadow-heavy cards; one black CTA per task area; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: loud AI gradients, purple/blue SaaS glow, chromatic repeated CTAs, oversized soft bubbles, heavy shadows, decorative orbs, watermark, raw implementation/debug text.
negativeConstraints: no distorted Korean text as final copy
